routePolicy: Historical gate unchanged; insufficient evidence => prospective foundation, not frozen dictionary

G0.requires: protocol/schema/catalog/state hashes fixed before payload audit

G1.requires: all synthetic guard tests and source-knownAt/mapping/action evidence pass; no future admission

G9.requires: G0-G8 all pass and admitted Tier1 >=1; freeze code/config/catalog/artifacts; no promotion

statistics.CI: Bonferroni8,95%; no IID row inference; two-way clustered sensitivity
statistics.controlModel: one linear residualization fitted first19 only, no search
statistics.drift: EW20/60/250 plus bounded250; compare short20 to nonoverlap prior20; insufficient history => UNKNOWN; drift confidence only
statistics.normalEB: log-scale where catalog says log; prior equivalent20 observations; prior variance fitted first19 only; weight nEff/(nEff+20)
statistics.peer: fixed tertiles of log-vol/log-turnover/log-price from first19; min30 securities per cell otherwise overall first19 prior; no sector fallback search
statistics.rateEB: Beta prior mean peer first19 with strength20; posterior Beta-binomial; nEff by distinct session events

prospective.freezeEarliest: after 60 distinct admitted exchange sessions AND G0-G8 pass AND >=1 Tier1; 250 metric remains INSUFFICIENT until250
prospective.clock: receipt time generated by capture, never caller backdated
prospective.collection: offline append-only intake; no scheduler or network activation; dedicated budget manifest required
prospective.seeds: zero historical profile eligible; no partial seed admitted
prospective.exposure: new captured sessions E1 and unavailable for later unseen Entry/EXIT claims
